result.prior_version_note: Before Measure BB (November 2024 election), the AGA followed the Rent Ordinance's 65%-of-Bay-Area-CPI formula, approved by voters in November 2004 (BMC 13.76.110A). D006 labels the 5% maximum as NEW, so the documents imply the earlier version had no 5% cap. The documents do not say when the AGA limit first applied, so in_force_since is left null.
